title: The Alphabet Beneath Things
evidence_boundary: This video presents symbolism, shifting focus, and multiple layers of consciousness as a metaphysical framework, not established scientific findings.
desired_movement: From treating symbols as labels attached to reality to experiencing them as living translations between feeling, attention, memory, and the physical world.
grounding: The ending returns symbolic consciousness to an ordinary object in the viewer's immediate surroundings.
invitation: Look at one familiar object and notice the invisible story it has been carrying for you.
end_card_question: What ordinary object has been carrying your invisible story?
voice_standard: Explain the idea to one curious friend with intimate confidence. Be playfully observant in the everyday examples, enchanted as symbols become fluid, tender around memory, and quiet enough at the end for the viewer to look around their own room.
